info.title: Blaaiz Platform API - Create Customer Wallet Addresses
info.description: Create static wallet addresses for one business customer.

CreateCustomerWalletAddressesRequest.description: Create addresses for one business customer.

customer_id.description: The ID of an eligible business customer.

post.description: Create static wallet addresses for one eligible business customer. Blaaiz creates an address for each active wallet network. Required scope: `crypto-wallet:create`.

400.description: The customer is not verified or is under Enhanced Due Diligence.

404.description: The wallet or customer does not belong to your business.

409.description: Address creation is active or awaiting provider confirmation.

422.description: The customer ID is missing or invalid.
